en: 1/12 scale Plastic Model Kit
R2-D2 (HOLOGRAM Ver.)
Reproducing R2-D2 in hologram state with a plastic model.
The hologram-projected R2-D2 is commercialized in BANDAI SPIRITS' Star Wars Plastic Model Series 1/12 Scale.
Adopts a clear blue molding color that resembles a hologram.
● CLEAR BLUE COLOR
R2-D2 during hologram communication is reproduced by using clear blue molding color on the whole body.
● DISPLAY BASE
A dedicated display base is included. Adopts clear blue molding color like the main body.
